text:
Gillette Stadium malitere iwu ya na 24 Maachị 2000 ma mepee ya na 11 Mee 2002, Robert Kraft kwadoro ya na ego nke $325 nde. HOK Sport (nke bụzi Populous) mere atụmatụ ya, Kraft Group nwekwara ma na-arụkwa ya kemgbe o mepere.

A malitere ya n’aha ọzọ. Site na 11 Mee ruo 4 Ọgọst 2002 a kpọrọ ya CMGI Field, mgbe e mechara nkwekọrịta ikike aha gbanwee ya ka ọ bụrụ Gillette Stadium. Maka 2026 World Cup a ga-akpọ ya aha FIFA neutral Boston Stadium.

Ụlọ egwuregwu ahụ nọchiri Foxboro Stadium dị nso, nke dị site na 1971 ruo 2002. Kemgbe o mepere, Gillette bụ ụlọ nke New England Patriots nke NFL na New England Revolution nke MLS. Ala egwuregwu ya agbanweela: ahịhịa sitere na 2002 ruo 2006, mgbe ahụ FieldTurf CORE artificial turf site na 2006, tupu ịlaghachi na ahịhịa maka World Cup. A hazigharịala oche ya maka bọọlụ America site na 68,756 n’oge mbụ ya ruo 65,878 na mgbe ahụ 64,628.

Ọrụ $250 nde ọzọ e mechara na 2023 gbanwere skyline nke ụlọ egwuregwu ahụ, tinye ụlọ elu lighthouse nwere okpukpu 22 nwere 360-degree observation deck, tinyere nnukwu bọọdụ vidiyo dị n’èzí.

Maka asọmpi 2026, ụlọ egwuregwu ahụ nwere otu n’ime ọrụ egwuregwu kachasị ukwu n’etiti ebe ndị ọbịa, a ga-eji ya mee egwuregwu asaa: ise n’oge otu, otu na Round of 32, na otu nkeji iri na ise — nke mbụ nke asọmpi ahụ, na 9 Julaị 2026.
